tool.name: NotebookLM
tool.summary: Google's personalized AI research assistant powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro, featuring Audio Overviews that turn uploaded documents into dynamic conversational podcast discussions.
tool.architecture: Grounded RAG pipeline powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro long context and conversational TTS.
tool.usage: Upload research papers, meeting notes, or PDFs at notebooklm.google.com, then click 'Audio Overview' to generate an engaging AI podcast explanation.
tool.benchmarks: Zero hallucination rate on user source documents through strict ground-truth attribution.
tool.limitations: Outputs strictly restricted to user uploaded source materials.
